column1: # OpenWrt platform matrix - single source of truth for both the local build scripts and the CI matrix.
#   tier: prime = first priority; common = widely used; extra = less common
#   extra_cflags uses **zig cc syntax**: zig selects CPUs with -mcpu=<cpu> and does not accept
#   GCC's -march=/-mfpu=.  The column may contain spaces, so it has to be last; empty = target default.
#   Note: the SDK workflow (sdk-static.yml) does not use these flags; it relies on the SDK toolchain.
